content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-15: A dry knot in the old fence post splits open with a papery click, and a dusty moth crawls out into the sun. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY guarded the knot-hole long enough for the moth to lift clear, losing a forage hour but keeping the moment whole.
content.branch_b_path: YY fetched Mira to witness the opening, and the ledger got quieter than usual around the word release.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: A dry knot in the old fence post splits open with a papery click, and a dusty moth crawls out into the sun.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
